How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIPER Guwahati Secretary to Registrar Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIPER Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Guwahati Secretary to Registrar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications and payment of fees is 19 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Secretary to Registrar post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized Institute or University. Additionally, proficiency in English typing at a minimum speed of 40 wpm is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for this position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of experience is required, specifically as a Personal Assistant or in an equivalent role within Central/State Government, PSUs, Universities, or Research Institutions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Secretary to Registrar post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Secretary to Registrar position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Secretary to Registrar position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 47,600/-. This is based on Level-8 of the Pay Matrix, with a basic pay of Rs. 47,600/-.

faq.question: Q7. What are the modes of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NIPER Guwahati Secretary to Registrar recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Secretary to Registrar role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally an Interview. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for departmental candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a provision for age relaxation for departmental candidates. They can avail of a 5-year relaxation in the upper age limit, as per the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
